start.procedure: Pair/count external /usr/bin/open -n owned.app --args [bound input], mandatory documented getApp/bootstrap, initial capture, exact owned PID/window accounting; reserve at most three 5-second waits plus observations for initial ready/rest state. No getApp before the external launch is confirmed live.

button.procedure: One click on a target from the immediately inspected observation, then one raw AX+screenshot capture and inspect before another input.

field.procedure: Click the currently observed numeric field; capture/inspect focus. One documented select-all key, one typeText with the exact original literal; capture/inspect raw value/caret. No AX presence claim for screenshot-only modal fields.

key.procedure: One documented key or typeText insertion followed by capture/inspection. Each Left caret move is its own key/capture. Tab always gets its own capture before the next input.

menu.procedure: Click observed menu, capture/inspect, click its observed action, capture/inspect.

save.procedure: Observed File > Save (four calls); only after clean saved-state capture, one external raw primary/sidecar snapshot invocation with paired receipt. No Save As, replacement output or JSON regeneration.

save_as.procedure: Observed File > Save as (four); if necessary one observed Go To Folder route (key/capture, exact folder type/capture, Return/capture; six); ONE setValue on the current observed editable/settable Name field and capture of exact literal basename plus enabled Save (two); one Save/capture (two); one external raw snapshot (one). Never hardcode an AX index or use a keyboard filename fallback.

save_as_failure.procedure: Same one-name-field route to original invalid-save.weftforge; one predeclared observed Replace confirmation allowed (two calls). Expected application validation failure; external byte/hash check preserves invalid destination and old recovery. This operation records no accepted snapshot.

open.procedure: Observed File > Open (four), one documented Go To Folder route with full exact owned file path (six), select/confirm the observed exact file if required and Open once (at most four). Capture the returned app state. No alternate chooser route or retry.

export.procedure: Observed File > Export format and native save chooser, one exact observed Name setValue + enabled-Save capture, one Save, same documented folder route if necessary; one external raw export hash/inventory. Maximum same as save_as, but no native-primary snapshot.

snap.procedure: Observed Snap dropdown click/capture, choose 5 mm/capture. Numeric endpoints bypass snap.

point.procedure: One complete click at a prospectively mapped original coordinate from the current observed canvas, then capture/inspect exact revision/preview. Record raw screenshot coordinates and conversion; no corrective click.

drag.procedure: One complete documented drag from currently observed endpoint to original target, then capture/inspect required revision and identity. Record raw screenshot endpoints and the one titlebar/content-Y hypothesis. No retry, numeric rescue or claim about held-state delivery.

recover.procedure: Observed File > Recover, Choose recovery file, one exact owned .recovery path through the documented chooser, select the uniquely observed exact row and Recover copy once, close that recovery window if still open, capture selection/history/preview reset. All inputs/captures count; ambiguous or duplicate row stops.

scroll.procedure: One observed inspector scroll, then capture/inspect before targeting a field. At most the prospectively reserved count; no hunting beyond cap.

ready.procedure: Up to three recorded 5-second waits, each followed by capture. Required ready/rest source revision, no Meshing/Simulating/Autosaving before dependent action; not retries of an input.

quit.procedure: One planned documented quit is the last native observer. Expected termination/close return only; no AX read or getApp on the closed app. Next CUA call contains only completion_summary exactly once.
